name: Value Boundary Leakage Owner Operator
trigger_conditions: operator may control schedule, docks, charging or dominant loads
anti_triggers: single owner-operator controls and captures all relevant loads
full meter and responsibility alignment documented
physical_basis: The physical driver of value can sit behind an operational boundary not controlled by the capital provider.
operational_basis: Schedules, equipment use, dock behavior or tenant loads may be governed by the operator instead of the owner.
financial_mechanism: Savings, compliance value or operational improvement can leak across responsibility boundaries before reaching the funding party.
typical_false_assumption: The party paying for improvement automatically captures the value created.
hypothesis: The actor funding improvement may not control or capture the variable that drives value.
rival_hypotheses: the same party controls and captures the dominant variable
metering and lease responsibilities already align
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: dominant driver controlled by operator or tenant
value capture pathway does not align with funding party
allowed_claim_language: The control boundary must be resolved before claiming owner-capturable value.
prohibited_claim_language: The owner will capture the savings.
financial_exposure_if_false: boundary leakage concern can be downgraded
owner-side economic framing may become more admissible
stop_conditions: responsibility matrix and meter boundary are bounded
escalation_conditions: operator confirmation required if public lease evidence is insufficient
example_outputs: If the actor paying for improvement does not control the driver, value may leak before it reaches the balance sheet.
tests: leased logistics case should activate this as plausible when meter and responsibility boundaries are unknown
